name: Chiseled Enchanting Table (Unofficial 26.3 Port)
description: Unofficial community port of Sacramentix's Chiseled Enchanting Table to Minecraft 26.3 / Fabric. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the original author. A rework of enchantment progression: you can now enchant your gear using enchanted books placed in nearby chiseled bookshelves using a chiseled enchanting table.

custom.chiseled_enchanting_table:port_notes: Unofficial Minecraft 26.3 port, version 1.1.0. Synchronized through 26.1.2 PR27 abb2af10 (2026-10-28), revision_22 survival UX, Cleanse extraction, 3D particles and tome batch/reload sync: tome pages/locks, live shelf snapshots, rule presets, Classic data tables and data-driven tags/loot. Uses independent 26_3_revision_13 protocol (ritual/tome wire changes and table visual events), 26.3 structure/render/loot/input APIs and recipes-list advancement schema. Audited runtime rule provenance, staged loot reloads, bounded cost payloads, Creative extraction and Iris texture reload lifecycle. See docs/reports/SYNC_9F0E13B_SEVEN_PATH_AUDIT_2026_10_26.md.
